# fonts

**Purpose:** The TrueType font faces the client interface renders with, plus the licence text for each family. Binary assets; nothing here is generated by the build.

## Key Components
- `Barlow-Regular.ttf`, `Barlow-Medium.ttf`, `Barlow-SemiBold.ttf` - Barlow, the face for running text and controls (design token `--font-ui`).
- `BarlowCondensed-SemiBold.ttf`, `BarlowCondensed-Bold.ttf` - Barlow Condensed, the display face for headings, title blocks and the company name (`--font-display`).
- `JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf`, `JetBrainsMono-Medium.ttf` - JetBrains Mono, the face for every figure, date and id (`--font-num`).
- `LICENSE-Barlow.txt` - SIL Open Font License 1.1, "Copyright 2017 The Barlow Project Authors".
- `LICENSE-BarlowCondensed.txt` - SIL Open Font License 1.1, same copyright holder as Barlow.
- `LICENSE-JetBrainsMono.txt` - SIL Open Font License 1.1, "Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors".

## Dependencies
- Loaded by file name through `Rml::LoadFontFace` in `game/src/main.cpp` and `game/src/layout_probe.cpp`; both hold the same hard-coded list of seven file names.
- Referenced by family name ("Barlow", "Barlow Condensed", "JetBrains Mono") in `game/assets/ui/main.rcss` and `game/assets/ui/tokens.rcss`.
- Copied with the rest of `game/assets` next to the `deep_claim` executable by the `deep_claim_assets` target in `game/CMakeLists.txt`.

## Patterns
- One `.ttf` per weight; weights are selected in RCSS with `font-weight` (400, 500, 600, 700).
- One licence file per family, kept beside the fonts it covers.

## Constraints
- The file names are load-bearing: adding, removing or renaming a face means changing the lists in `main.cpp` and `layout_probe.cpp`.
- All three families are under the SIL OFL 1.1; the licence files travel with the fonts.
